description: Confirm that a memory is still current using explicit present evidence. Never call this merely because read_memory returned the content. Use only after a current user assertion, an authoritative current source, or direct observation. Refreshes validity but does not change content or key links. A strong restatement passed as recall's `context` is already auto-confirmed there (check memories[0].auto_confirmed) — this tool is for evidence recall can't see: read_memory results, authoritative sources, or direct observation.
name: confirm_memory
